posts.topic_title: Projection of transmission hologram onto ground glass
posts.author: tpark
posts.post_subject: Projection of transmission hologram onto ground glass
posts.content_md:
> **MichaelH:** Neat. Are you planning on making a transfer of that?

I made a transmission H2 from it, and it was kind of cool, but I've not made any reflection holograms from it yet. Part of the problem is that it wasn't made with a collimated beam, so it's not so suitable as a master. Now that I have some reasonable mirrors I may shoot a new master, or at least give this one a shot and see how it turns out.

posts.post_subject: Projection of transmission hologram onto ground glass
posts.content_md: Try a want add. It worked for me when there were no items listed. I was very specific as I designed my new table around a specific telescope mirror. But if you requested a 10"-12" fast mirror (or whatever you decide you need) for less than $200 I am sure people would contact you. I chose not to mention I was taking the mirror out of astronomy because I figured I would get more help that way.
